distribution.provenance: The native NeMo candidate consumes the canonical .nemo checkpoint from the exact NVIDIA model revision without conversion, mirroring, or quantization.

limitations: Only the 19 transcription-ready and 13 broad-coverage locales accepted by ADR 0024 are enabled; adaptation-ready prompt entries remain Unknown evidence.
NeMo language tags are validated against the restored checkpoint prompt catalog, retained as automatic-language evidence, and removed from spoken transcript text before scoring or publication.

The pinned unified cache-aware NeMo wrapper accepted prompt_vectors without applying them in the checked inference path. Yap therefore validates the checkpoint prompt catalog and applies the selected prompt projection after the encoder and before RNNT decoding; this first-party correction remains pinned-source regression surface.

The checked cache-aware profile uses 1.12-second chunks, [56, 13] attention context, BF16, and one scheduler owner for all shared pipeline mutation. The checkpoint rejected the generic [70, 13] profile.

On the locked public fixture, fixed en-US matched all 23 normalized reference words but omitted one comma; automatic mode matched the exact golden transcript after locale metadata was excluded from spoken text. Representative frozen-corpus promotion evidence remains incomplete.

Native checkpoint restoration took approximately 29.5 seconds in focused GB10 probes. A non-gate resident-service probe then formed one batch of eight independent requests, acknowledged cancellation in 13 milliseconds without publishing a result, recovered immediately, and released its container and loopback port; this is development evidence, not production capacity or promotion.
Automatic inference remains limited to bounded finalized utterances; a whole long recording cannot be relabeled as one dynamic utterance.
Persistent supervision, authenticated ownership, mixed-user capacity, and production deployment remain later gates.

Focused exact-duration controls completed a true 30-second c2 model batch plus c1 2-minute, 15-minute, 2-hour, and exact 4-hour finalized-window inputs. The 4-hour repeated-fixture control completed in 279.865 seconds, including 275.702 seconds inference and 2.688 seconds accumulated queue time, with 2.356 GiB current usage under the 96-GiB container ceiling and clean teardown. Repetition makes this duration/lifecycle evidence only; sentinel integrity, natural long-form quality, frozen percentiles, and promotion remain open.
